manifestations.description: anxiety, fear and distress exhibited while recalling the physical assaults
loss of concentration and increased forgetfulness; mind becomes completely blank at times
dermatitis scars and discolouration of the skin on feet, ankles and lower calves
embarrassment and avoidance of wearing revealing clothing such as skirts, dresses or sandals

treatments_received.treatment: admitted to Amal Sehat Islamic Hospital Sragen and treated; various scans performed
source: Shortly after returning to Indonesia, the plaintiff was admitted to Amal Sehat Islamic Hospital Sragen in Solo, Central Java on 11 January 2014 due to multiple injuries on her head and limbs. She was examined and treated by a number of doctors and various scans were performed during her hospitalisation.

treatments_received.treatment: further examination and treatment at Kasih Ibu Hospital (February to April 2014)
source: From February to April 2014, the plaintiff attended Kasih Ibu Hospital and was further examined and treated.
A Head CT scan was performed in late 2015 which showed no significant abnormality.

treatments_received.treatment: repair of cracked and displaced front teeth in Indonesia
source: Her cracked and displaced front teeth have also been repaired in Indonesia.

treatments_future.treatment: psychiatric follow-up on a monthly basis for two years
source: (a) psychiatric follow-up on a monthly basis for two years, with antidepressant medication treatment to be taken for at least one year (and likely to require two years depending on response);

treatments_future.treatment: antidepressant medication treatment for at least one year (likely two years depending on response)
source: (a) psychiatric follow-up on a monthly basis for two years, with antidepressant medication treatment to be taken for at least one year (and likely to require two years depending on response);

treatments_future.treatment: psychological treatment by a clinical psychologist: weekly sessions (40-50 minutes) for half a year, then every two weeks for another one year
source: (b) psychological treatment by a clinical psychologist (each session for 40 to 50 minutes) on a weekly basis for half a year, and every two weeks afterwards for another one year.
